## Checklist

- [ ] JSON is valid and imports without errors into n8n
- [ ] All nodes are connected — no dangling nodes
- [ ] All credentials use placeholder values only (no real secrets)
- [ ] `meta.infoBay` metadata block is complete
- [ ] File follows `kebab-case-descriptive-name.json` naming
- [ ] File is in the correct `templates/<category>/` folder
- [ ] A row has been added to the correct table in `README.md`
- [ ] Workflow has been tested end-to-end on n8n 1.x
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing template
